snippet.title: Fields of Aaru - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Fields of Aaru is a cozy life sim set in the mystical afterlife of Ancient Egypt, where you'll build a home along the Nile, befriend the locals, farm, fish, and venture into the desert to uncover ancient ruins, tombs, and hidden secrets.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4410710/Fields_of_Aaru/
